text:
jasper: T-30 for release 3.7.0 — planning prod cut at 2026-03-17T16:00 PT. Deploy lane: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Rollback plan below. Please ack and confirm smoke owners.

tayla: Ack. I'll own smoke tests. Will run web and inference smoke. Staging canary passed earlier.

maria: I'll own DB migration monitoring and alerts. Migration is non-blocking but I'll watch replication lag.

samir: I'll be the deployer and trigger the rollout. @tayla can you paste the smoke commands? I'll also be ready to pause/roll back.

tayla: Smoke commands:
```bash
# web smoke
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://prod.app/health
# inference smoke (tiny prompt)
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"hello","max_tokens":5}'
```

lucy: Quick watchlist I'm watching: GPU/CPU util, p50/p95 latency, token errors, 500s. Dash: <https://dash.redwood.ai/d/abcd/3.7-smoke|3.7 smoke dashboard>.

deploy-bot: Deploy window opens in 25m. Reserved canary lane: gpu-pool-3. Autoscale reported OK.

maria: DB monitor query I'll use: 
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM migrations WHERE status='running';
```
Alert if > 0 after 10m. Also watching replica lag: SELECT max(replica_lag_seconds) FROM pg_stat_replication;

jasper: Checklist (quick):
- [ ] Deployer: samir
- [x] Smoke owner: tayla
- [x] DB monitor: maria
- [ ] Ops oncall informed: @ops-oncall
- [ ] Rollback playbook ready: samir
- [ ] Rollout schedule pinned in calendar

samir: Rollback playbook (short):
```text
1) Pause rollout
2) Revert model route to redwood-1-stable
3) If DB migration issues, restore from replica snapshot -> failover
4) Notify clients + open incident if >5% errors
```

tayla: I'll post smoke test results here with timestamps when I run them. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Acked. I'll standby and escalate if we see error spike > 3% or latency > 2x baseline.

lucy: Infra status: GPUs warmed, no node drain in progress. No known infra blockers.

maria: All good from DB side, replication healthy.

samir: Ready on deploy side. Will start at T-0 when jasper says GO.

jasper: Final ask before GO at T-5: any blockers?

lucy: none

maria: none

samir: none

jasper: GO in T-2 unless objections. :rocket:

(timestamps and results to be posted in-thread during rollout)
